naming_note: Requested as 'B3 v2'. A B3 v2 (b3_b4_candidate_review_v2_20261002) was already published and locked on 2026-10-02, so this draft is numbered v3 and adds only the section-3 simulation bindings. v1, v2 and their locks are untouched.
purpose: Bind the four persisted surfaces, ledger kinds and naming, per-ledger limits, the instrument-capacity ledger rule and the outcome-blind smoke-replay window rule for the 16-model dual-stream roster. Contains no outcomes and grants no collection, scored, paper, alert, order or promotion authority.

carried_from_v2_unchanged.rule: At publish time these v2 sections are copied verbatim; this draft does not restate or alter them.

ES.opportunity_universe: v2 scope.common_opportunity_universe, formed from ES bars, ES matcher and ES predictions only.
ES.execution_and_freshness: v2 streams.ES.execution_assumptions and freshness_and_eligibility (first scheduled open strictly after known_at, max one 5m bar, 90 s prediction age, 30m inputs < 30 min, others < 60 min).
ES.cost_stress: double_all_costs on the identical admitted trades and fills
ES.session_reporting_clock: london_07_16_ny_08_17_asia_ny_v1 as spelled in v1/v2; the frozen cost contract names london_07_16_ny_08_17_asia_ny_19_02_v1 (see decision D7)

expected_move.used_by: full_policy only; no model has an exact full-policy binding yet

ES.calendar: pmc_5_1_3_cme_globex_equity_plus_carter_v1 as used by the B1 candidate review harness

independent_model_variant.capacity_scope: this ledger only (model x variant x cost case)

ES.capacity: ES only. Never consumes, reserves or releases EURUSD capacity.

EURUSD.opportunity_universe: v2 scope.common_opportunity_universe, formed from EURUSD bars, OTE matcher and OTE predictions only.
EURUSD.execution_and_freshness: v2 streams.EURUSD.execution_assumptions and freshness_and_eligibility (first scheduled EURUSD open strictly after known_at, max one 5m bar, 90 s prediction age, 30m structural < 30 min, 1h structural and others < 60 min).
EURUSD.cost_stress: double_all_costs on the identical admitted trades and fills

expected_move.rule: No frozen EURUSD expected-move contract. ES ticks and the unversioned expected_move_pips field must not be used.

EURUSD.calendar: undefined: no pinned EURUSD expected-open calendar identity was found in the B1 harness (see decision D6)

independent_model_variant.capacity_scope: this ledger only (model x variant x cost case)

EURUSD.capacity: EURUSD only. Never consumes, reserves or releases ES capacity.

raw_score_gross_forward_response.population: Every causally recorded prediction, above or below threshold, with its setup-match state.
raw_score_gross_forward_response.content: Raw score, calibrated probability, threshold and pass flag, plus gross forward response from the first scheduled open after known_at at the six B1 horizons (1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 48 bars) with MFE/MAE, in stream units and ATR units.

setup_only.admission: Every common opportunity on its executable route; no probability filter, no policy gate.

setup_threshold.admission: The same opportunities with calibrated_probability >= the exact B4 v2 threshold float; equality accepted.

full_policy.admission: The same opportunities after the frozen threshold and the exact candidate policy binding, when one is frozen.
full_policy.undefined_rule: not_defined produces no ledger, no rows, no P&L, no zero-trade result and no pass.

event_markout_separation.rule: Per-event markouts (forward response and the per-signal paper contract outcome, which is independent of capacity, quantity and costs) are stored in a markout store, never in a position ledger. Position rows carry capacity admission, costs and net P&L and are stored only in ledgers. Counterfactual pooled matches are markout-only and can never create a position row.

full_policy_status.note: ES has a frozen expected-move contract and a v1/v2 intended policy specification, but no per-model policy manifest or policy hash is frozen. EURUSD additionally lacks an expected-move contract. See decision D8.

kinds.independent_model_variant: One ledger per model x variant x cost case. No model or variant consumes another's capacity. Used for overlap and correlation measurement.
kinds.instrument_capacity: One ledger per stream x cost case with one position per instrument across all of that stream's models. Reported under its own name and never added to, averaged with or ranked against independent ledgers.

ledgers.reporting_guard: A report table may contain rows of exactly one ledger_kind, one stream and one cost case. Markout stores and ledgers are never placed in one P&L table. Mixing fails closed.
ledgers.unresolved_exposure: An admitted position without a resolved exit stays UNRESOLVED, keeps its capacity, and is reported as open exposure, never as zero P&L.

smoke_replay.purpose: Verify setup routing, entries, exits, costs, ledger accounting and replay hashes for each exact selected version. Profitability is recorded as advisory and is never interpreted, tuned on or used as a veto.

inputs_allowed: setup-match presence per route from the frozen replacement's recorded held-out predictions
inputs_forbidden: any column derived from future bars
window_rule.unit: one trading week of the stream's calendar
window_rule.selection: Per model, greedy set cover with earliest-week tie-break over the required elements; stop when every coverable element is covered or the cap is reached.
required_elements: each route of the model (at least one contemporaneous same-side setup match)
an RTH segment (ES) or London/New York segment (EURUSD)
window_rule.unexercised: A route or calendar element with no eligible week is recorded as unexercised with its reason. It is never forced, synthesized or substituted.
window_rule.determinism: The chosen weeks, the element-to-week map and the unexercised list are written and hashed before any outcome is computed.

session_coverage.rule: Full eligible session coverage. setup_only and setup_threshold apply no hour, session or weekday gate. The only session exclusions that may ever apply are those inside an exact frozen full-policy binding; session and hour fields are report slices only.

decisions_needing_approval.question: Which variant feeds the instrument-capacity ledger?
decisions_needing_approval.recommended_default: The intended full policy where exactly defined, otherwise setup_threshold, with the feeding variant labeled on every entry. With all 16 not_defined, every entry is labeled setup_threshold.

decisions_needing_approval.question: Capacity-ledger priority rule.
decisions_needing_approval.recommended_default: Earliest decision time (known_at); ties broken by frozen selection order (roster.selection_order), then opportunity key. This replaces the v2 tie-breakers (availability time, opportunity key, position key) for this ledger only.

decisions_needing_approval.question: Does an open position block every other entry on that instrument until it closes?
decisions_needing_approval.recommended_default: Yes. An open or unresolved position blocks all entries on that instrument, same side or opposite, with no pyramiding, no reversal and zero cooldown after close. A same-bar exit does not free capacity at that bar's open.

decisions_needing_approval.question: Concurrency inside each independent model x variant ledger.
decisions_needing_approval.recommended_default: One position at a time, one unit, no opposite side, zero cooldown (the v2 portfolio terms applied inside the ledger). Every-signal independence is already retained in the event markout store.

decisions_needing_approval.question: Smoke window unit and cap.
decisions_needing_approval.recommended_default: Whole trading weeks, at most 4 weeks per model, earliest-week tie-break, restricted to the model's held-out period.

decisions_needing_approval.question: EURUSD expected-open calendar identity for the B1 tape.
decisions_needing_approval.recommended_default: Pin one versioned EURUSD 5m calendar derived from features/fx_calendar.py before any EURUSD smoke replay; until pinned, EURUSD smoke stays not_run rather than inferring closures from bars.

decisions_needing_approval.question: ES session clock spelling (v1/v2 text versus the cost contract).
decisions_needing_approval.recommended_default: Treat both spellings as the single frozen clock london_07_16_ny_08_17_asia_ny_19_02_v1 implemented by outcome_engine.session_at; record the alias, change no behavior.

decisions_needing_approval.question: Full-policy status during section 3.
decisions_needing_approval.recommended_default: Keep all 16 not_defined. Binding an exact ES policy needs per-model policy manifests and a new B4 freeze version; it is not done here.

decisions_needing_approval.question: Where the capacity priority rule is implemented.
decisions_needing_approval.recommended_default: Add an optional ordering key to the shared position simulator that defaults to current behavior, publish it as b1-v5 and keep b1-v4 reproducible from archived engine source. No B1 contract changes.

decisions_needing_approval.question: Protocol numbering.
decisions_needing_approval.recommended_default: Publish this as B3 v3 with v2 as parent, since v2 is already locked.
